CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2579 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2. Bus nonce: fabf465ca534b864017249d81a9bbb57. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2` or `Fix review: blocked 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: fabf465ca534b864017249d81a9bbb57`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2579 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2579-fabf465c`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
RE-REVIEW, round 5, of PR #2579 (group R10-FLOW-YIELD-PROBE, branch fix/r10-flow-yield-probe) at head 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2. The fixer's code is handoff/r10-flow-yield-probe 384a0e8c, merged with main by update_pr.sh. Read the round-4 verdict with `git fetch origin review/2579; git show FETCH_HEAD:VERDICT.md`. Rounds 2-4 each blocked on one-line mutants of tools/audit/seat/review_strength.py that passed its self-test and moved body figures. This round replaces one-at-a-time pinning with a class sweep, dev/audit/harnesses/r10_review_strength_mutants.py, under a stated operator-class rule. Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at that head, using the finder's harness the group brief names. PREPR_SKIP_CLOSURES=1.
Required:
- Judge the class rule, adversarially. Do the operator classes and bounds in the harness header cover the shapes that survived in rounds 2-4? Hand-write at least 5 mutants OUTSIDE the stated classes, aimed at the figures the body quotes. Each survivor that moves a quoted figure is a finding.
- Check every DISPOSED entry. Is the claimed equivalence real? An "equivalent" that changes any output on some input is a finding.
- Re-run the sweep (body: every survivor killed or disposed) and the self-test (body: 96 checks), each with a null control. Confirm the tool changes the sweep forced move no figure on the real bus (body: Null control). Re-derive every figure in the body and in dev/audit/rounds/round10/D13/yield-probe.md.
- Third-round rule. This is round 5. If the body is longer than its content needs, say so as a finding. A further block on figures should name exactly what to split out.
- carry_audit.py check over the body gives 0 unrouted. Every Carry names a live group on main's roster.
- git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main 6ad8089c14b50de2f6408ef6948a7d86ca4c52c2 must be clean. Read check-runs at this head: a red whose log shows "API rate limit exceeded" or "API is unreachable" is external. nightly-status and delivery-status are not required.
- ev/HEAD.txt holds the full head, and VERDICT carries bus-nonce: fabf465ca534b864017249d81a9bbb57. No /Users/ or /private/ path may appear in VERDICT.md or ev/.
